info.title: AIOps Canvas Backend API
info.description: Single-workspace multi-application SRE API. All business history is server authoritative; application authorization is enforced beyond minimum workspace role.

post.description: Minimum role: public. Sets HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie; browser writes require matching Origin.
Minimum role: viewer.
Minimum role: admin.

patch.description: Minimum role: admin. Role/password/disabled changes revoke existing sessions; last active administrator cannot be removed.

delete.summary: Remove member while retaining historical identity
delete.description: Minimum role: admin. Soft-delete and disable account, revoke sessions. Last enabled administrator is protected. No destructive deletion of investigation or audit history.

post.description: Minimum role: admin. Connector credentials remain server-side configuration; registering metadata does not grant tool access.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Contains no provider URLs, credential paths or secrets. Configured status is not a successful connectivity check. Configuration changes require server deployment configuration; there is no settings write API.

get.summary: Read registered Deployment image and revision summary
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Only registered application scope is accepted. Returns images and replica counts, not full Pod templates or environment variables. Unconfigured applications return 404. This GET never executes a rollback.

post.description: Minimum role: operator.
Minimum role: operator. One active run per branch. Repeated request ID with same payload returns same run; changed payload is 409. Model is frozen per run.
Minimum role: operator.

patch.summary: Set branch title or future model

post.summary: Preview an explicit merge or parent sync
post.description: Minimum role: operator. No authority is transferred by merging context.

Minimum role: operator. Source/target revision drift or consumed preview returns 409. Target becomes a new revision. Omitted message_ids selects all; explicit empty/unknown/duplicate selections are rejected. evidence_only creates read-only provenance references and does not copy approvals. Only full direct-parent message synchronization advances the parent watermark.
Minimum role: operator.

put.description: Minimum role: viewer. Scoped to current user. Does not mutate branch history or cancel a run.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Uses greatest supplied cursor. event:update, id:decimal sequence, data:Event JSON. Heartbeats are comments. Consumers deduplicate by seq. Delta events belong to an attempt and are not final assistant history; reconcile by GET investigation.

get.summary: List source documents and latest index status

post.description: Operator with application permission; workspace sharing requires administrator. Draft creation never publishes knowledge or grants access.
Minimum role: operator. Old successful generation remains until new build commits. Current embedding identity controls retrieval.
Filter current ACL, publication state and environment before keyword/vector fusion. Embedding failure returns explicitly marked keyword fallback.

post.summary: Propose rollback to an explicit owned revision
post.description: Minimum role: operator.
Minimum role: operator. Self-approval is permitted for operators/admins. Repeated approval does not duplicate authorization or audit.
Minimum role: operator. One execution per immutable plan. Drift requires new plan/approval. Ambiguous outcome is reconciled without blind write retry.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. succeeded requires 180 seconds of traffic, healthy probes and converged approved Deployment; command success alone is insufficient.

get.summary: Find the existing execution without queueing work
get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Read-only lookup for refresh/resume. Returns 404 if the plan has no execution; never authorizes or queues a write.

get.summary: Read context snapshot, provenance and referenced evidence

post.description: Minimum role: operator. Terminal decision for this plan; repeated same decision is idempotent. No external write.

post.summary: Revoke approval before execution is queued
post.description: Minimum role: operator. Rejected if an execution record already exists. Revocation cannot undo queued or completed effects.

post.summary: Close after successful recovery and save report
post.description: Minimum role: operator. Requires the latest completed action to have succeeded and no active inference or action execution in this investigation. Same execution replay returns immutable report. Closed investigations reject new branch/context mutations.

get.summary: List unconfirmed and confirmed experience drafts

post.description: Minimum role: operator. Evidence IDs must belong to this investigation; drafts are not searchable knowledge.
Minimum role: operator. Requires closed investigation. Atomically creates one source document; retries return same document. Index failure keeps source for explicit reindex.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Routes are available when AIOPS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG is configured; no credentials are returned.

post.description: Minimum role: operator. Server-registered query IDs only, no arbitrary PromQL. Defaults up to last15m and 15s, constrained by registered window/sample limits; explicit time and response limits enforced. Empty is not healthy proof.
Minimum role: operator. Registered exact Loki labels; cannot override LogQL/endpoint/scope. Default last15m/100 lines; empty is not healthy proof.

post.summary: Archive or restore without deleting history
post.description: Minimum role: admin.
Minimum role: admin.

patch.description: Minimum role: admin. Full environment update; binding_revision is optimistic concurrency token. Secrets stay in server registration.

post.description: Minimum role: admin.

put.description: Minimum role: admin. Workspace role caps grants; owner fields do not confer permissions.

post.description: Minimum role: operator. Human-pinned, not a fresh measurement. Source/time/query remain in immutable content. Same environment and idle branch required.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Derived summary does not replace raw history; estimates are conservative UTF-8 byte bounds, not exact provider token usage. 404 means no prepared context yet.

post.description: Minimum role: operator.

get.summary: Export authorized source revisions and metadata

post.summary: Generate experience draft after verified closure
post.description: Minimum role: operator. Uses bounded configured model with committed evidence; human review and publication remain required.
Minimum role: operator.
Minimum role: operator. Omit model_id for manual investigation without a model call.

get.description: Minimum role: viewer. Use workspace for administrator-only defaults. Background model calls default off.

post.description: Minimum role: operator.

get.summary: Read workspace attention and derived todos

post.description: Minimum role: public. Requires dedicated Bearer source token; server-side mappings bind scope. Deduplicates source/fingerprint/startsAt, late firing cannot undo resolved state.
Minimum role: admin. Administrator-supplied exported directory data; no remote IAM requests or SSO. Email collisions do not take over local identities.
Minimum role: admin. Recomputes preview and commits atomically. New entries are disabled viewers without a usable password; current roles and app grants are not imported.

available.description: Configured adapter; not proof of a successful remote health check.
